key_effect_directions.claim: C3 relative-representation retention of native Recall@5 meets or exceeds 0.80 at 1,024 random anchors on the primary pair in both directions and both seeds
C3 work-level provenance survival is at least 0.90 under the frozen gate (primary pair, Q1, 1,024 random anchors, both directions, both seeds)
C4 paired-anchor Procrustes retention stays at or above 0.50 of native Recall@5 on the primary pair in both directions, so the KILL criterion does not fire

forecast.rationale: TR-002r already certified that paired-anchor Procrustes recovers retrieval on this encoder pair, so a C4 retention collapse below 0.50 is unlikely and KILL is a thin tail. Q1 cues are 60-word excerpts of the target chunk, so native Recall@5 will sit near ceiling and a large share of that signal can survive Moschella coordinates at 1,024 anchors; even so, the gate demands the conjunction of 0.80 retention, 0.90 work provenance, and 0.05 confident-wrong on random (not medoid) anchors in both directions and both seeds, and a near-miss is scored FAIL, which is the modal outcome.
